auth.title: Sign in to KEMI
auth.subtitle: Use your company email and password.
auth.noSelfSignup: Accounts are created by an admin. Contact your admin for access.

users.title: User management
users.desc: CEO only: create new accounts and assign their role.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.subtitle: KEMI needs an internet connection to load data. The app shell stays open; reconnect to continue.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Overview of KEMI activity and system status.
dashboard.placeholder: Data will be available in the next phase.

agents.title: Agent Center
agents.subtitle: Your digital team. Only agents authorised for your role are shown.
agents.placeholder: The agent list will be available in the next phase.
agents.empty: No agent is permitted for your role and division yet.
agents.knowledgeDemo: KEMI internal sample data (not yet connected to the live system).
agents.knowledgeNone: No data source is connected for this agent yet.

chat.title: Chat
chat.subtitle: Converse with KEMI.
chat.placeholder: The chat interface will be available in the next phase.
chat.pickAgent: Pick an agent to start a conversation.
chat.sourcesEmpty: Sources appear after the agent answers.
chat.factVsAnalysisDesc: The agent marks what is fact from the data and what is analysis. If data is missing it says so instead of inventing it.
chat.deniedBody: You are not authorised to use {{agent}}.
chat.deniedUnknown: Agent not found or not active.
chat.notEnabled: {{agent}} is not enabled for chat in this phase.
chat.requestSoon: Access requests go live in the next phase.
chat.errorForbidden: Access to this agent was denied.
chat.errorRate: Too many requests. Please try again shortly.
chat.errorUnavailable: The AI service is unavailable. Contact your admin.
chat.errorGeneric: Could not send the message. Please try again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Display and language preferences.
settings.note: Preferences are stored in your user profile and follow you to other devices.

profile.title: My Profile
profile.subtitle: Change your own name and profile photo.
profile.invalidType: Unsupported photo format. Use JPG, PNG, or WEBP.

access.title: Access Requests
access.subtitle: Request access to agents you are not authorised for yet, and track the status.
access.dialogDesc: Explain why you need it. The request is routed to the authorised approver.
access.purposePlaceholder: Example: I need to monitor my team's attendance weekly.
access.errorPending: You already have a pending request for this agent.
access.errorAlready: You are already authorised for this agent.

approvals.title: Approval Inbox
approvals.subtitle: Requests waiting for your decision. You cannot approve your own request.

audit.title: Audit Log
audit.subtitle: Trail of data access and key actions. Read-only.

briefing.title: Daily Briefing
briefing.subtitle: Cross-division executive summary from the daily snapshot
briefing.generatingHint: Arca is consulting the agents you are allowed to use. This can take a few minutes.
briefing.emptyNarrative: No summary yet. Click "Build briefing" to let Arca compose it from the agents you may use.
briefing.failed: The briefing could not be built. Please try again.
briefing.forbidden: You are not authorised for the Daily Briefing yet. Request access to the Arca agent first.

actions.pageSubtitle: Drafts, approvals, and controlled execution for actions that change data. AI never executes without human approval.
actions.dialogDesc: This draft only records an intended action. Nothing changes until it is approved and executed.
actions.title: Draft Title
actions.errorForbiddenAgent: You are not permitted to use this agent.
actions.errorInvalidPayload: The draft data is incomplete or invalid.
actions.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
actions.pendingEmpty: No drafts are waiting on your decision.
actions.decideFailed: The decision could not be saved.
actions.executableEmpty: No drafts are ready for execution.
actions.errorSegregation: You cannot execute a draft you submitted yourself.
actions.errorForbiddenExecute: You are not authorized to execute this draft.
actions.errorExecutionFailed: Execution failed. See the result detail under the draft.
actions.myEmpty: You have not created any action drafts yet.

admin.title: Admin
admin.subtitle: Manage users and roles. Only super admins can access this page.
admin.sessionNote: Organisational role changes affect a user's data access from their next session/refresh, and remain subject to the existing agent permissions.
admin.roleConfirmDesc: {{name}}'s role will change from {{from}} to {{to}}. This affects that user's data access.
admin.grantDesc: {{name}} will be able to change the profile and role of every user. This is recorded in the audit log.
admin.revokeDesc: {{name}} will no longer be able to manage users and roles.
admin.errLastSuperAdmin: Rejected: there must always be at least one super admin.
admin.errSelfRevoke: You cannot revoke your own super admin access.
admin.errForbidden: You are not authorised to do this.
admin.errGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
admin.agentsNote: Edit each agent's name, description, colour, photo, and active status. Changes show immediately in Agent Center, the sidebar, and chat.
admin.photoInvalidType: Unsupported photo format. Use JPG, PNG, or WEBP.
